name: Murujuga Cultural Landscape
description: Murujuga is a rugged coastal landscape in Western Australia's Pilbara region, taking in the Burrup Peninsula, the islands of the Dampier Archipelago and the surrounding waters. Its rocky hills are covered in a dense concentration of carved rock art, made over thousands of generations. The Ngarda-Ngarli, its Traditional Owners, have cared for this land for more than 50,000 years.
